1) Bridge letter: Security will produce a one-page interim bridge letter on Redwood letterhead that states:
   - The audit period (2026-07 through 2027-06)
   - That Redwood is undergoing a SOC 2 Type II audit and that the report for that period is in finalization (estimated availability: mid-Oct)
   - A short statement of confidence with pointer to controls we can substantiate now

2) Control excerpt: We will export the minimal control matrix for encryption, IAM, and change control into control_matrix_excerpt.csv (control id, short description, owner, evidence location link). Target: 48 hours.

3) Full report: We are unable to publish the final Type II externally until legal signs off on redactions. If Arcadia requires the full file for procurement, we can provide a secure, access-controlled copy to be reviewed under an NDA; earliest realistic delivery is Oct 14 after legal review.

4) Evidence sprint: I will own the 72-hour evidence scrub. Jonas will handle the encryption evidence pulls; Karthik will coordinate the change-control artifacts and link to Cloud audit logs.

Attachments: bridge_letter_draft.docx (will be provided in next message) and control_matrix_excerpt.csv (after export).

If everyone agrees, I'll start collecting artifacts and push a draft bridge letter to Marissa by EOD tomorrow.

-Rishi
